newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Irkutskenergo sees ADRs next month.
newsitem.headline: Irkutskenergo sees ADRs next month.

text.p: Russian power utility Irkutskenergo said on Friday it anticipated its planned issue of level one American Depositary Receipts to become active next month.

It said in a statement it had received exemptions under the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) rule 12g3-2(b) for the issue and that the Bank of New York was expected to file form F-6, seeking final permission for the issue, on Friday.
Irkutskenergo (Irkutskoye AO Energetiki i Elektrifikatsii) rose to $0.116 from Thursday's close of $0.110 on the Russian Trading System.
ADRs are securities which allow investors access in the United States to invest in foreign shares without the complexities of settlement in the issuer's market.
Level one ADRs are the simplest and do not raise new capital.
